children.text: Columbus roofing
Columbus, OH Roof Replacement Company
When an aging, leaking, or storm-damaged roof can no longer protect your home with confidence, Roof King & Restoration helps you plan a replacement that is clear, durable, and built for Ohio weather.
As a GAF Master Elite contractor serving Columbus and Central Ohio, Roof King helps homeowners compare repair, replacement, financing, and warranty options before committing to a full roof system.
Repair or replace
Know When A Full Roof Replacement Makes Sense
Not every roofing issue needs a tear-off. If damage is isolated, a targeted
roof repair
may be the smarter path. If leaks keep returning, shingles are failing across multiple slopes, or storm damage has compromised the system, replacement can protect the home more completely.
Small leaks, a few missing shingles, minor flashing issues, or localized wind damage can often be addressed without replacing the entire roof.
Older roofing, widespread granule loss, curling shingles, soft decking, recurring leaks, or damage across several areas can point toward a full system replacement.
Hail, wind, ice, and heavy Ohio weather can shorten a roof system's life. Our team can inspect the roof and document what we find before you decide.
Warning signs
Signs You May Need Roof Replacement

Homeowners usually call when a leak becomes obvious, but many replacement clues show up earlier. Watch for missing or lifted shingles, curling edges, bald spots where granules have washed away, dark streaking, repeated repairs, daylight in the attic, soft or sagging decking, damaged flashing, ventilation problems, and roof age that is approaching the end of its expected life.
A complete inspection helps separate cosmetic wear from problems that can let water reach the decking, insulation, drywall, and interior finishes of your home.
Installation process
A Roof Replacement Process Built Around Clarity

Roof King keeps the project straightforward from inspection to cleanup. You get a clear scope, product guidance, schedule expectations, and a finished system designed to handle rain, wind, heat, ice, and everyday Ohio weather.
We review shingles, flashing, decking, ventilation, storm damage, and leak history before recommending the right path.
Choose colors, shingle profiles, ventilation, underlayment, and warranty options that fit the home and budget.
Our crew removes the old system, checks the decking, installs protection layers, and completes the roofing system with care.
We clean the property, check the finished details, and walk through the completed work before the project wraps.
Materials and cost
Roofing Systems, Cost Factors, And Warranty Protection

The right roof is more than the visible shingle. Material choice, ventilation, flashing, underlayment, decking condition, labor, disposal, pitch, access, and warranty coverage all affect the finished result and the final price.
Roof King installs asphalt shingles, architectural shingles,
metal roofing
, and premium
GAF roofing systems
. Compare more options on our
roof types
page.
Size, pitch, tear-off needs, decking repairs, ventilation, warranty selections, and storm conditions all matter. Start with our
roof replacement cost guide
or
roofing calculator
Our work is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty, and GAF product options may provide additional manufacturer protection depending on the system selected.
When wind, hail, ice, or falling debris is involved, we can inspect the damage and help you understand next steps. Learn more about
storm damage restoration
and
insurance claims

sections.title: Answers Before You Replace Your Roof
sections.description: Use these questions to understand scope, timing, warranty, and when replacement is the right move for your home.

items.question: How do I know if I need a roof replacement?

children.text: You may need replacement if your roof has widespread shingle wear, recurring leaks, storm damage across multiple slopes, soft decking, sagging areas, or age-related failure that repairs cannot reliably solve.

items.question: How long does a roof replacement take?

children.text: Many residential roof replacements can be completed quickly once materials and scheduling are set. In Columbus and Central Ohio, timing can also depend on seasonal weather, storm demand, material scheduling, roof size, pitch, decking repairs, and project complexity.

items.question: How much does roof replacement cost in Columbus, OH?

children.text: Cost depends on roof size, pitch, tear-off needs, material, ventilation, decking condition, labor, disposal, and warranty selections. Our roof cost guide and calculator can help you start planning.

items.question: Do you tear off the old roof?

children.text: Roof King evaluates the existing system and recommends the right installation approach. A tear-off often gives the crew a clearer look at decking, flashing, and hidden water damage.

items.question: What roofing materials do you install?

children.text: We install asphalt shingles, architectural shingles, metal roofing, and GAF roofing systems, with color and style options selected for Ohio homes, curb appeal, and year-round weather exposure.
Yes. Roof King offers financing options that can help homeowners plan roofing, windows, gutters, siding, decks, and other exterior projects.

items.question: What warranty comes with a roof replacement?

children.text: Roof King provides a 5-year workmanship warranty, and manufacturer warranty options may be available through GAF depending on the roofing system selected.

items.question: Can storm damage qualify for insurance coverage?

children.text: Wind, hail, ice, and other Central Ohio storm events may qualify depending on the damage, policy, and inspection findings. Our team can document roof conditions and help you understand the next steps.
If decking is soft, rotted, or compromised, it should be addressed before the new roofing system is completed. We review decking during the project and explain any needed repairs.

items.question: Do you serve areas outside Columbus?

children.text: Yes. Roof King serves Columbus, Central Ohio, and communities across Ohio for roofing, storm damage, siding, gutters, windows, decks, and attic insulation.

Choose a GAF Master Elite Roofer in Columbus, OH, for expert roof repair, installation, & Lifetime Warranty shingles. Trust GAF-certified quality & reliability!
Why Choose A GAF Master Elite Roofer?
Specializing in
roof related services in Columbus, Ohio

. We have been continually trained by GAF Materials Corporation in the latest roofing techniques, installation, product knowledge, and awareness. If you need roof repair or a new roof, is the roofing contractor of choice due to our experience and our use of weather rated products with Lifetime Warranties.

Below we have detailed all the product and warranty information needed to research the GAF Roof system and its unparalleled reliability. There is a reason they are the #1 selling shingle in North America.
Established Reputation
– Only 2% of all roofing contractors have qualified as Master Elite
Properly Licensed
– All GAF-certified contractors possess the credentials necessary to install or repair roofs in the United States
Legitimate Insurance
– Adequately insured for your protection. We must also carry full insurance policies, to protect ourselves and homeowners in case something goes wrong on a job.
Commitment to Ongoing Training
– The roofing industry is always changing, with new products, new technologies, and new techniques and best practices. GAF certification requires that roofing contractors commit to on going training.
GAF LIFETIME SHINGLES

The longevity of your roof system depends greatly on roofing materials of the construction. So if you seek the most efficient roofing solution, ask certified specialists from Roof King & Restoration for professional help. We specialize in residential roofing to assist property owners with their roof installation, repair, and replacement needs.

With so many options to choose from these days, picking the right color shingles for your homes’ roof can be a challenge. Roof King & Restoration is a proud certified partner with GAF, one of the largest residential shingle manufacturers. We believe in
GAF’s products
and the warranty they offer.
GAF Roof System
A roof replacement is an investment that you shouldn’t hesitate on. Since your roof protects your interior the most, you shouldn’t pick anything but the best as a replacement.
New HDZ Shingle
The new Timberline HDZ Shingles are compatible with traditional Timberline HD Shingles for the same look and feel homeowners and contractors rely on for beauty and endurance.
7 Key Danger Signs
Don’t get caught with sudden, costly repairs. Keep a close eye on your roof and find out how to spot problems, including these 7 key danger signs – before they severely impact your wallet
Look For:
Rook Leaks
After a strong storm or wind-driven rain, take a look in the attic for signs of leaking. It could indicate damaged shingles, inadequate underlayment or deteriorated flashing.
Stains
: Stains, or worse, mold, can be caused by leaks from outside the house or moisture trapped inside.
Blistering/Peeling Paint
: Moisture trapped in the house due to poor ventilation can cause exterior paint to peel and blister.
Exterior Decay
: Excess moisture can also contribute to decay.
Missing, Cracked,  and Curling Shingles
: Dry, cracked, or easily broken shingles have reached the end of their useful life, and it is time to invest in a new roof.
Excessive Energy Costs
: Inadequate ventilation can possibly drive up your household cooling costs by trapping hot air in the attic. Attic moisture can also drip into your insulation, reducing its effectiveness.
Dark, Dirty Areas on the Roof

: Vegetation, fungus, mold, or algae growth can cause dark stains on your shingles. That does not necessarily mean you need a new roof, but if you do choose to replace your shingles, ask for StainGuard protection available on many GAF Shingles
GAF Virtual Home Remodeler
Choose the Right Shingles!
Homeowners face a number of challenges when remodeling their home. One of the most common problems they encounter is
choosing the material that will complement their home’s architectural style

. If you’ve considered upgrading your roof but have found yourself overwhelmed with the options, you can turn to GAF s Virtual Home Remodeler. Whether you have a traditional or contemporary design, youre sure to find the best GAF roofing options from their wide selection of shingle types and colors. You can even get a sneak peek of your new roof before installing it using GAFs revolutionary app.
GAF Shingle Roof Warranty
We Protect What Matters Most

When you invest in a new roof, you expect that roof to last. But sometimes there are issues that have arisen during the manufacturing or installation process that are not discovered until after your roof has been on your home for a while. Understanding the different warranty options available to you before you purchase your new roof is vital.
